user.title: Choose a Feel24 gym
user.description: Start typing to find your gym, then select it from the list.

error.invalid_center: Select a valid Feel24 gym from the list.

init.title: Visitor notification
init.description: Choose when to be notified about a low visitor count. Notifications must also be enabled with the notification switch.

data_description.notification_threshold: Notify when the visitor count moves from above this threshold to at or below it.
data_description.notification_time_mode: Notify all day or only within a selected time window.
data_description.notification_target: The mobile device or notify entity that receives the push notification.

schedule.title: Choose notification time
schedule.description: The time window may cross midnight, for example 22:00–02:00.

error.same_notification_time: The start and end time cannot be the same. Select All day to receive notifications at all times.
